exposure: Financial incentives (Romanian Diagnosis-Related Group (Ro-DRG) payment system)
cohort: The study analyzed 149,466 childbirth cases reported through the Ro-DRG system in 2020 from all 191 Romanian hospitals (171 public, 20 private) that reported deliveries.
finding: The national CS rate in Romania was 52.9% in 2020, with private hospitals reporting significantly higher rates (79.8%) compared to public hospitals (49.7%), suggesting financial incentives might contribute to increased CS rates.
mod_finding: The national CS rate was 52.9%, with private hospitals having a 79.8% CS rate compared to 49.7% in public hospitals, and the study suggests financial incentives might be a contributing factor to the high rates.
